title: Refactor Database Connection Strings
problem_statement: Database connection strings are hardcoded, leading to security and maintainability issues.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential exposure of sensitive data and deployment inflexibility.
suggested_approach: Refactor the code to use environment variables or configuration files for database connection strings.
success_criteria: Database connection strings are no longer hardcoded.
Application can connect to the database using environment-specific configurations.
